# Wiki Emitter

The Wiki Emitter compiles knowledge into an OKF-conformant Markdown format from a knowledge intermediate representation (IR). It manages the regeneration of wiki pages, ensuring that only 'dirty' pages are rewritten while always updating the index and recent changes.
